## Problem and behavior

Describe the trigger, the resulting behavior, and the user outcome. Link the story/defect and affected domain context.

## Evidence

List the checks actually run and link reproducible artifacts. Distinguish measured results from planned targets. For research changes include negative/unknown cases and scenario scope.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe schema/API/semantic changes, migration, failure recovery, and material limitations. Write “not applicable” when appropriate.

## Review

- [ ] I checked data/code rights and excluded secrets and private strategies.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior.
- [ ] I identified whether review was independent or self-review with AI assistance.
